name: print-social-city-resto-posts-maroon-with-gold-line-leaves
title: City Resto pack in deep maroon with gold condensed type, line leaves and zigzag bands
whatItIs: Five maroon posts with a boxed script 'City RESTO' logo, gold condensed uppercase headlines ('Living Cuisine', 'The best food in town!'), photos of diners and noodle bowls, thin gold line-drawn leaves and zigzag and diagonal stripe bands at corners.
whatItMeans: Rich and warm; maroon and gold feel like an evening dining room.
techniques: Use a two-tone maroon and gold palette.
Add fine line botanicals behind photos.
Put stripe bands in corners as frame accents.
Box a script logo for a signage feel.

vocabulary.definition: A strip of repeating zigzag lines.
